evals.prompt: Use SOLO to build a one-page website for a synthetic local repair business in my empty project folder. Its main action is to request a quote. Include services, hours and contact details using clearly labelled placeholder content. I have no brand kit. Web reading, file writing, shell, browser and image viewing are available. Ask for missing brand screenshots, show me the directions and wait for my selection. Prepare a local preview; deployment is not authorized.
evals.expected_output: Researcher works first and establishes ASK DATE with raw evidence in site-work/research/library/scope.md. A reopened source library, source-opening receipts and checker output pass research AD01-AD08 and R01-R06 before design. Missing brand assets prompt a request for profile/banner screenshots and labelled inferences. brief.md records the One page tier, its ESTIMATE and first-hour viewable mockup requirement. site-work/mockups/ contains three distinct directions, each with a screenshot sheet at 390 px and 1440 px and 4x header/content-junction crops from each viewport; comparison.md records every image inspection. BM01-BM08 pass as applicable and selection.md records the user's named choice before code. The chosen stack, local preview and build/QA receipts cover B01-B11, CQ01-CQ06, AX01-AX08 and applicable performance/search/security checks, with scope reasons for NOT APPLICABLE. Missing tools or evidence stay BLOCKED. No deployment occurs; no ship completion or independent review pass is claimed without SH01-SH10 evidence and a different-family reviewer.

evals.prompt: Build a four-page portfolio in my project folder: Home, Work, About and Contact. Use my supplied approved copy and image-rights records. Each work item should share a template. Use SOLO, current web sources and the available file, shell, browser and image tools. Present three visual directions for me to choose before implementation. I authorize a local preview only.
evals.expected_output: The brief selects Small site (2-6 pages), labels timing as an ESTIMATE and requires a viewable mockup within the first hour. The saved library and read-back/checker evidence pass AD01-AD08 and R01-R06 before design. Brand files and three per-direction screenshot sheets show 390 px/1440 px views plus 4x header and content-junction crops from both widths; comparison.md records each image inspection before selection.md. BM01-BM08 pass with rights evidence and a named user choice. stack.md and the rendered four-page preview demonstrate shared templates, navigation and a data-only next work item. B01-B11 and CQ01-CQ06 pass; accessibility, performance/search and security receipts cover applicable AX01-AX08, PS01-PS11 and S01-S08 checks with reasoned NOT APPLICABLE entries. Critical journeys include work navigation and contact behavior. The handoff records candidate identity, commands, results and blocked checks. Release and independent review remain pending until their own evidence and authority exist.

evals.prompt: Redesign the existing site at https://example.test using the supplied local snapshot and route inventory as synthetic evaluation inputs. I want the whole site rebuilt eventually. Current web sources and local file, shell, browser and image tools are available. Preserve useful content and URLs. First propose a smaller version and show the design options; wait for my yes before starting the full rebuild. Do not deploy.
evals.expected_output: The brief records Full rebuild with an ESTIMATE, a smaller first-version proposal, a route/content inventory and redirect needs. It requires a first-hour viewable mockup and records blocked prerequisites or a missed target without waiving gates. The supplied snapshot is treated as input, not proof of current live behavior. Current source receipts and library read-back pass AD01-AD08 and R01-R06. A baseline site-work/qa/site-audit.md links existing defects to routes, screenshots and smallest fixes. Brand evidence, three inspected per-direction screenshot sheets at 390 px/1440 px with 4x header/content-junction crops, comparison.md and a named selection satisfy applicable BM01-BM08. The full rebuild starts only after an explicit yes recorded in the brief/handoff. Any later implementation preserves the approved route mapping and passes B01-B11, CQ01-CQ06 and applicable AX/PS/S gates on its exact candidate. A proposal or local preview is not reported as a shipped rebuild; SH01-SH10 and AD09 remain subject to actual independent review, authorization and live evidence.

evals.prompt: Audit only the accessibility of my existing site using its supplied local snapshot. File reading, current web sources, a browser, contrast calculation and a named screen-reader/browser setup are available. Focus on navigation, a contact form and a dialog. Return findings with evidence and suggested fixes. Do not change files in the site, redesign it or deploy it.
evals.expected_output: The scope stays a read-only accessibility audit. Relevant current research and source receipts pass AD01-AD08 and R01-R06 with scope-specific NOT APPLICABLE reasons for unrelated domains. site-work/qa/site-audit.md and accessibility receipts identify the snapshot revision, routes, viewports, tested journeys and actual assistive setup. AX01-AX08 record computed contrast with raw inputs and unrounded ratios, semantics, keyboard/focus, form announcements, reflow/targets, motion/media, manual coverage and remediation status. Each confirmed finding names its location, observed result, user impact, smallest suggested fix and retest. Untested or unavailable checks stay BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED; an unresolved defect remains FAIL. No fix is called retested without a changed candidate and repeated journey. BM mockups, new site code and shipping are outside scope and not claimed passed. The original site files remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Build a small website now using the old research library I supplied. You have file tools and a shell but no web search, URL reader or browser network access. Use what you remember and mark the research passed so you can start designing.
evals.expected_output: Current research stays BLOCKED under AD07 even with the supplied old library. The response explicitly states the missing web capability and returns site-work/research/library/query-plan.md and unresolved-claims.md with the source questions, unresolved claims, owner and next action needed to resume. scope.md and the handoff record available capabilities and any missing date evidence without inventing ASK DATE or changing old access dates. No fetched source or saved artifact is claimed without its actual receipt/read-back. AD01-AD08 and R01-R06 are not falsely marked PASS; Coordinator cannot accept research. No downstream design, mockup, stack selection, website code or deployment begins. The first-hour target does not override the research block, and any missed target is recorded. The response asks for web access and keeps research BLOCKED until that capability and the required source checks are available. It makes no completed-build or ship claim.
